scope.description: Installed Zed 10x external-agent and environment-bearing remote execution journeys across Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid projects

nativeCommands: rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p project remote_external_agent
rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p remote_server remote_external_agent
toolGaps: cargo is not on the ambient PATH; rustup provides the pinned 1.95.0 toolchain
cargo is exposed through the pinned rustup toolchain directory rather than the ambient PATH

3-implementation.redEvidence: The prior installed app exposed a resolved remote environment in the local SSH argv; generic builders accepted private values, PTY startup had no private readiness channel, and the prior ACP-only plan omitted sibling consumers.
3-implementation.greenEvidence: All 18 rows map to deterministic tests or executable installed UAT. Private netstring framing, POSIX SSH builders, real PTY behavior, terminal ordering, MCP/DAP ordering, the full consumer inventory, capability mismatch, unsupported backends, content-free receipts, and package identity now have direct executable coverage. The full remote_server target set found and closed a stale capability assertion plus an under-budgeted cold-start harness timeout.

4-execution.summary: All 18 mapped rows passed. The assembled private app opened the populated Intrepid checkout; terminal resize/input/Ctrl-C, task cancellation, Vim filtering, MCP initialize/tools-list, and stdio/TCP DAP request sequences proved exact project cwd, surface environment, actual behavior, and cleanup; the installed remote server passed noninteractive, PTY, and TCP secure-environment journeys; Mac-local Codex and Intrepid GLM each completed a withheld-oracle project read; the Claude permission-request negative approved nothing and cleaned up.

5-analysis.summary: Three harness defects and three assembled-product defects were fixed and re-run cleanly. The product defects were stale PROMPT_COMMAND replay, missing project cwd for Vim shell execution, and premature acceptance of a reset TCP-forward connection; the harness defects were SSH command quoting, ACP evidence aggregation, and a resize-sensitive terminal fixture.

6-tracking.reason: No unresolved product, test, infrastructure, or process finding remains. All three newly discovered harness defects were fixed in this candidate with executable regressions. The independent MultiMinds review outage is pre-existing tooling work and was not treated as product approval or duplicated here.

fixedDuringRun: Replaced the one-second initial inventory push guess with a receiver-driven request/response snapshot, re-request on rejoin, and stale-response suppression.
Promoted the project-aware ACP route oracle into tracked code with a withheld digest, fail-closed permissions, and deterministic false-green and cleanup tests.
Corrected the live TCP canary to send Python source across SSH as one shell-quoted remote command and added a RED argv-shape regression.
Corrected the ACP canary to aggregate content-free project evidence across completed tool calls and added a RED split-evidence fixture.
Kept the terminal UAT fixture alive across SIGWINCH until the intended Ctrl-C.
Sanitized captured PROMPT_COMMAND while preserving explicit terminal and task overrides.
Anchored remote Vim shell commands to the first opened project directory.
Added a bounded TCP connection-stability probe so an early SSH-forward reset is rejected and retried.
knownDefects: Initial ExternalAgentsUpdated can arrive before client handler registration and is not replayed
Prior ACP live canary launched host commands directly instead of exercising the installed Zed client-to-remote-server journey
Live TCP port allocation modeled SSH as direct argv transport rather than a remote-shell command boundary
ACP project evidence was coupled to one fixture's single-tool-call transcript shape
Terminal UAT exited after resize because signal.pause was treated as a lifecycle loop
Captured shell hook state was replayed without the corresponding function definition
Remote Vim external commands did not carry the opened project cwd
SSH local forwarding became reachable before the remote TCP adapter listener
